claims.statement: CĐ08–CĐ10 production batch passed source-scope structural QA, strict MkDocs build, deploy workflow and gh-pages smoke checks.
CĐ08 Practice Bank was expanded from 120 to 132 questions so all three newly modeled Grade 9 Core order-property skills have real interactive practice coverage.
Each topic now has five Core Learning Cards, 15 micro-practice items, 10 Core Readiness MCQs and 10 written Core exercises.
Frozen Golden Template v1 and source-locked Core/Extension boundaries are not open for redesign in this review.

proposed_changes.change: Review mathematical correctness, age-appropriate wording, distractor plausibility, misconception coverage, progression across the five cards, and quality of written solutions. Return issue-level corrections only.
proposed_changes.rationale: ChatGPT remains production/schema/source lead after two earlier source-scope failures in authoring relay.

tests.expected: No KNTT Core boundary changes unless backed by explicit source evidence.
No new topic IDs, skill IDs, schema fields or engine changes proposed as if already accepted.
Every reported math error includes the exact item ID and corrected answer/reasoning.
Distractor critique identifies ambiguity/equivalent-answer risk by exact item ID.
Written-solution review flags any algebraic or modeling error with exact exercise code.

uncertainties: Gemini may suggest pedagogical improvements outside current scope; such suggestions must be labeled optional and must not be treated as accepted architecture changes.

acceptance.notes: Return ONE review packet for the deployed CĐ08–CĐ10 batch. Do not rewrite the full batch. Report only verified issues, pedagogical refinements, and optional suggestions, each tied to exact item/exercise IDs.
